Ruletas con sub-ruletas, retos y una mas: Wheels with sub-wheels, challenges and a mascot that gets dizzy
🎡 Ruletas: crea todas las que quieras en: 🎡 Wheels: create as many as you want in “Wheels”. Each prize has a name, emoji, color and a weight that decides how likely it is (you see the percentage instantly), and it can have a maximum number of times per stream.
Cada ruleta gira sola cuando tú quieras:: Each wheel spins on its own whenever you want: with a subscription, a Kick store redemption, a specific gift or one by value, a new follower, every so many likes, a chat command like !ruleta (for everyone, subscribers or mods, with a per-person cooldown), a share or a superfan. Spins line up and play one at a time, with the name of who spun it.
Sub-ruletas: un premio puede abrir otra: Sub-wheels: a prize can open another wheel (up to 6 levels), and with “＋ Create the sub-wheel” you build it without leaving the editor. A prize can also play a sound from your library, have the voice read a text, have the bot write in the chat, add or remove time from the countdown, change a counter, skip the song or spin again.
En el centro de la ruleta aparece Samy,: Samy, Troya, Ñoño or Juana shows up in the center of the wheel (at random or the one you pick): spins with the wheel, gets dizzy with spiral eyes and little stars, wobbles while braking, then celebrates with confetti or gets scared if you landed a challenge. With ticking pegs, a bouncing pointer, running lights and 6 color palettes.
Retos pendientes: marca un premio como r: Pending challenges: mark a prize as a challenge and it stays in “Wheels → History and challenges” until you tap “✓ Done”. The menu shows how many you have pending. The history of every spin is there too.
Overlay de ruletas para OBS y TikTok LIV: Wheels overlay for OBS and TikTok LIVE Studio (720 × 860), also in “OBS overlays”. It only shows up when a wheel spins, and each wheel has its own link if you want it in a separate source. The app decides the result, so it lands on the same prize in every source.
Los botones «Llévame ahí» de los guías q: The guides' “Take me there” buttons that went nowhere now work: Mechanizer's for Live chat, Samy's for the platforms you use, Troya's for Special viewers and Ñoño's for music commands and limits. We checked all 50 of them.
Al tocar «Reiniciar y actualizar», Satro: When you tap “Restart and update”, Satronho Bot closes instantly to free its files for the installer. Before, it waited to close everything calmly and, on some PCs, the installer couldn't replace the app and the new version didn't stick.
Si una versión no se puede instalar, ya: If a version can't be installed, it no longer asks you to update over and over without explaining anything: it tells you why it failed (for example, the antivirus checking the files), what to do, the folder to add to your antivirus exclusions with a button to copy it, and a “Retry” button.
Satronho Bot guarda un registro de sus a: Satronho Bot keeps a log of its updates (which version it found, when it downloaded it and whether it installed). It's included in “Report a problem” so we can see right away what happened.
